text:
sahil: quick question — we need to lock windows for the v2.15.0 deploy next Wed. can we do a quick async check on US/EU/APAC cutoffs? trying to avoid overlap with the infra migration.

maria: +1. what's the current plan for canaries? i thought we were doing us->eu->apac with 30m canaries each?

sahil: that's the suggestion. proposed timeline in UTC: canary US 08:00-08:30, EU 12:00-12:30, APAC 20:00-20:30. cutoffs: branch freeze 06:00 UTC, changelog final by 04:00 UTC.

ken: FYI the DB migration team prefers EU to be before APAC by at least 3h so they can finish smoke tests during eu daytime. would that force us to shift?

sahil: good catch. we can shift APAC to 23:30 UTC if needed (still same local evening). that keeps eu->apac gap. any objections?

jamal: can we avoid midnight local deploys for APAC teams — last time we woke a bunch of folks. if APAC still needs late evening, try 21:30-22:00 UTC instead?

maria: 21:30 UTC is ok for APAC ops. that would make sequence: US 08:00, EU 12:00, APAC 21:30. gap between eu and apac becomes ~9.5h which gives DB team time.

lucy: tagging release checklist items: please ensure the following are done before 04:00 UTC cutoff: 1) changelog.md updated in release branch, 2) release-notes PR merged, 3) release image pushed to registry. i put a short template in #eng-releases-checklist.

release-bot: deploy window reservation confirmed: v2.15.0 - reserved slots: US 08:00-09:00 UTC, EU 12:00-13:00 UTC, APAC 21:30-22:30 UTC. reservation id: R-2150-4782.

devops-oncall: quick ops note — autoscaler warmup for the new pool will take ~20m after the first canary spike. suggest we start canary traffic at 08:10 for US to give kube nodes time to warm.

sahil: ok let's nudge schedule: US canary start 08:10-08:40, EU 12:10-12:40, APAC 21:40-22:10. updating the timeline.

ken: branch coordination: please open your release PRs against release/v2.15.0 by 02:00 UTC so we have time for last-minute CRs. i'll ping reviewers at 02:10.

maria: changelog ping: @all -- paste one-liners under the Changelog section. i'll assemble. :memo:

jamal: rollback owner? if rollback is needed for APAC late, who is on deck?

lucy: rollback owner will be @jamal for APAC, @ken for EU, @sahil for US. add to incident doc?

release-bot: checklist reminder in 2h: run `./scripts/verify-release.sh --branch release/v2.15.0` and `orchestrator status --id R-2150-4782`

maria: small snippet for automated schedule (internal support):
```
orchestrator schedule --id R-2150-4782 \ 
  --region us --start 2026-04-15T08:10Z --canary 30m \ 
  --region eu --start 2026-04-15T12:10Z --canary 30m \ 
  --region apac --start 2026-04-15T21:40Z --canary 30m
```

ken: looks good. i'll monitor PR queue at 02:10 UTC and put a qa hold if anything blocks.

sahil: thanks all. i'll update the release page and set the branch freeze calendar event. if anything else pops up, drop it here and i'll triage. :rocket:
